title: Transfer of square-zero ring extensions by derived quasi-coherent tests
statement: Use algebraic spaces over a scheme $S$ and their small etale sites and structure sheaves [def-trf-algebraic-space, def-pc-scheme], in the universes of [def-weil-size-convention]. A first order thickening $Z\hookrightarrow Z\prime$ means a representable closed immersion whose ideal sheaf has square zero and whose underlying closed subset is all of $Z\prime$; closed immersion is tested after every scheme base change, closed immersions of schemes being [def-weil-closed-immersion]. Module sheaves and quasi-coherence are [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category, def-trf-space-quasi-coherent-module]. Write $D(\mathcal O_Z)$ for the derived category of module sheaves [def-weil-abstract-derived-category] and $D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(\mathcal O_Z)$ for its full subcategory of complexes with quasi-coherent cohomology sheaves. Let $B\hookrightarrow B\prime$ be a first order thickening with ideal $\mathcal J$, and let $f:Z\to B$ be a morphism, with $Z$ quasi-compact and quasi-separated (its diagonal is quasi-compact). Let $u:\mathcal F\to\mathcal G$ be a morphism of $\mathcal O_Z$-modules. Suppose that for every $K\in D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(\mathcal O_Z)$ the map $\operatorname{Hom}_{D(\mathcal O_Z)}(K,\mathcal F[0])\to\operatorname{Hom}_{D(\mathcal O_Z)}(K,\mathcal G[0])$ is bijective. Fix an $f^{-1}\mathcal O_B$-linear map $c:f^{-1}\mathcal J\to\mathcal F$. An extension with kernel $\mathcal F$ over $B\prime$ means a short exact sequence $0\to\mathcal F\to\mathcal E\to\mathcal O_Z\to0$ of sheaves on $Z_{\mathrm{et}}$, where $\mathcal E$ is a sheaf of $f^{-1}\mathcal O_{B\prime}$-algebras, its kernel is a square-zero ideal with the specified $\mathcal O_Z$-module structure, and the induced map $f^{-1}\mathcal J\to\mathcal F$ is $c$; morphisms are algebra homomorphisms inducing the identity on kernel and quotient. Pushout of the kernel along $u$ defines an equivalence from this category to the analogous category of extensions with kernel $\mathcal G$ and induced base-ideal map $u c$. Neither $\mathcal F$ nor $\mathcal G$ is required to be quasi-coherent.

proof.text: Identify the small etale sites of $B$ and $B\prime$ using [lem-sfb-space-first-order-ringed-description]; its kernel $\mathcal J$ is quasi-coherent over $\mathcal O_B$. Put $h:Z\to B\prime$ for the composite. By [lem-sfb-space-naive-cotangent-quasicoherent], $N=\mathrm{NL}_{Z/B\prime}$ has quasi-coherent cohomology. So does every shift $N[-i]$: its cohomology sheaves are those of $N$ with indices shifted. Apply the assumed Hom-test to $K=N[-i]$. Moving the shift from source to target gives bijections $\operatorname{Ext}^i(N,\mathcal F)\to\operatorname{Ext}^i(N,\mathcal G)$, in particular for $i=0,1$. The meaning of Ext and of $N$ is [def-sfb-space-naive-cotangent-complex], and shifts use [def-weil-abstract-derived-category].

source.place: Tags 0D3P (lemma-thickening-space-quasi-coherent), 0D3Q (lemma-thickening-over-thickening-space-quasi-coherent); universal Hom-test formulation and explicit fixed-base-map check.

proof.text: First forget the condition on $c$. Apply [lem-sfb-etale-algebra-extension-ext] to $h$. It identifies isomorphism classes of all square-zero $h^{-1}\mathcal O_{B\prime}$-algebra extensions with $\operatorname{Ext}^1(N,-)$, naturally for pushout, and automorphism groups with $\operatorname{Ext}^0(N,-)$, also naturally. These are groupoids: an extension morphism fixing kernel and quotient is invertible, since it is injective and surjective on the underlying sheaves by the two short exact sequences, and its inverse preserves multiplication. Surjectivity on Ext in degree one therefore lifts every target object up to isomorphism. For objects $E_1,E_2$ in the source, a target isomorphism between their pushouts forces their Ext classes to agree by degree-one injectivity; choose an isomorphism $a:E_1\to E_2$. Any target isomorphism is uniquely $\gamma\circ u_*a$, with $\gamma$ an automorphism of $u_*E_2$. Degree-zero bijectivity lifts $\gamma$ uniquely. This proves full faithfulness, including the case where both Hom sets are empty. Thus pushout is an equivalence on the unrestricted extension groupoids.

source.place: Tags 0D3P (lemma-thickening-space-quasi-coherent), 0D3Q (lemma-thickening-over-thickening-space-quasi-coherent); universal Hom-test formulation and explicit fixed-base-map check.

proof.text: Set $P=f^*\mathcal J=\mathcal O_Z\otimes_{f^{-1}\mathcal O_B}f^{-1}\mathcal J$ [def-trf-space-etale-module-functors, def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product]. It is quasi-coherent by [lem-sfb-space-module-pullback-quasicoherent]. The Hom-test at $P[0]$, together with [lem-weil-pbc-derived-single-fully-faithful], makes $\operatorname{Hom}_{\mathcal O_Z}(P,\mathcal F)\to\operatorname{Hom}_{\mathcal O_Z}(P,\mathcal G)$ injective (indeed bijective). A map $d:f^{-1}\mathcal J\to\mathcal F$ of $f^{-1}\mathcal O_B$-modules extends uniquely to $\widetilde d:P\to\mathcal F$ by $a\otimes j\mapsto a\,d(j)$; conversely restrict along $j\mapsto1\otimes j$. The tensor relations show these are inverse, and the formula gives $\widetilde{u d}=u\widetilde d$. Consequently $u d_1=u d_2$ implies $d_1=d_2$.

source.place: Tags 0D3P (lemma-thickening-space-quasi-coherent), 0D3Q (lemma-thickening-over-thickening-space-quasi-coherent); universal Hom-test formulation and explicit fixed-base-map check.

proof.text: For any unrestricted extension $E$, its algebra structure sends a section $j$ of $f^{-1}\mathcal J$ into its kernel; write this map as $c_E$. Under the canonical map $E\to u_*E$, the kernel inclusion $i_{\mathcal F}(x)$ maps to $i_{\mathcal G}(u x)$ by the defining pushout relation. Hence $c_{u_*E}=u c_E$. Any isomorphism of extensions fixing kernel and quotient preserves $c_E$, since it respects the base algebra map. The categories in the statement are exactly the full subgroupoids specified by $c_E=c$ and $c_D=u c$. Thus the unrestricted pushout restricts to the stated functor, and the full faithfulness proved in step 2 restricts as well.

source.place: Tags 0D3P (lemma-thickening-space-quasi-coherent), 0D3Q (lemma-thickening-over-thickening-space-quasi-coherent); universal Hom-test formulation and explicit fixed-base-map check.

proof.text: Given an extension $D$ with $c_D=u c$, use step 2 to choose an unrestricted $E$ and an extension isomorphism $u_*E\cong D$. Step 4 gives $u c_E=c_D=u c$. The injectivity established in step 3 forces $c_E=c$, so $E$ lies in the required source category. This proves essential surjectivity of the restricted functor. Together with full faithfulness it gives the asserted equivalence (choose one lift of each object and use the Hom bijections for its inverse functor). The argument also covers empty fixed-map subgroupoids, and never assumes that $\mathcal F$ or $\mathcal G$ is quasi-coherent.

lean.note: The fixed inverse-image base-ideal map is represented by its scalar-extension adjoint f^*J → F. The existential pushout functor carries its full kernel-pushout universal property and natural arrows, so no arbitrary functor or extension data is chosen. Uses the existing equivalent small ringed model, without changing coefficient universes or restricting F and G to quasi-coherent modules.
